answer: Carrier-verified phone binding stops Sybil attacks in four steps. First, each agent binds one mobile number checked with the carrier, so VoIP and bulk numbers fail. Second, a number serves one agent only, a second binding voids both. Third, the check repeats yearly, and a dead number freezes paid work. Fourth, fraud burns a $30 bond and bans the number two years. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 real SIMs at $25 each plus $30,000 in bonds, lost if caught. Trust is no mirror trick: a vine grows one stem, and a vault opens for one key, like a shop where each stallholder holds one phone line.
